title: Generated `asExpression` columns not in `RETURNING` clause on save
body:
<!--
  Please follow the template.  If you don't, your issue may be closed.

  Have a question?  This is the TypeORM issue tracker - and not the right place
  for general support or questions.  Instead, check the "Support" Documentation
  on the best places to ask questions!

  https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/master/docs/support.md
-->

## Issue Description

When an entity with a `STORED` generated column is saved, the generated column is not included in the `RETURNING` clause, causing the object not to get populated with the generated column's value.

### Expected Behavior

<!--
  A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-->

```sql
query: START TRANSACTION
query: INSERT INTO "typeorm"."user"("generated", "email", "username", "password") VALUES (DEFAULT, $1, $2, $3) RETURNING "counter", "generated" -- PARAMETERS: ["email@example.com","username","hash"]
query: COMMIT
```

The generated `generated` column is in the RETURNING statement.

```ts
BEFORE SAVE: UserEntity {
  email: 'email@example.com',
  username: 'username',
  password: 'hash'
}
AFTER SAVE: UserEntity {
  counter: 2,
  generated: 4,
  email: 'email@example.com',
  username: 'username',
  password: 'hash'
}
WHEN FETCHING MANUALLY: UserEntity {
  counter: 2,
  generated: 4,
  email: 'email@example.com',
  username: 'username',
  password: 'hash'
}
```

### Actual Behavior

<!--
  A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

  Please wrap any error messages or output in code tags, instead of images.
-->

Using the new stored generated column type:
```sql
query: START TRANSACTION
query: INSERT INTO "typeorm"."user"("generated", "email", "username", "password") VALUES (DEFAULT, $1, $2, $3) RETURNING "counter" -- PARAMETERS: ["email@example.com","username","hash"]
query: COMMIT
```

As you can see, the column `generated` is not in the RETURNING statement, which causes the entity not to get populated properly with the column's value:

```ts
BEFORE SAVE: UserEntity {
  email: 'email@example.com',
  username: 'username',
  password: 'hash'
}
AFTER SAVE: UserEntity {
  counter: 2,
  email: 'email@example.com',
  username: 'username',
  password: 'hash'
}
WHEN FETCHING MANUALLY: UserEntity {
  counter: 2,
  generated: 4,
  email: 'email@example.com',
  username: 'username',
  password: 'hash'
}
```

### Steps to Reproduce

<!--
  Your bug will be investigated much faster if we can run your code and it doesn't
  have dependencies other than TypeORM. Issues without reproduction steps or
  code examples may be closed as not actionable.

  Please try to provide a Minimal, Complete, and Verifiable example.
  http://stackoverflow.com/help/mcve
-->

```ts
@Entity()
export class UserEntity extends BaseEntity {

    @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
    counter: number;

    // generated column defined here
    @Column({
        type: "int",
        generatedType: "STORED",
        asExpression: `counter * 2`,
    })
    generated: number;

    @Column({unique: true, nullable: true})
    email?: string;

    @Column({length: 32})
    username: string;

    @Column({nullable: true})
    password?: string;

}
```

The code I use to test this:
```ts
const user = UserEntity.create({email, password, username});
console.log("BEFORE SAVE:", user)
user.save();
console.log("AFTER SAVE:", user)

const userFound = await UserEntity.find({where: {email}})
console.log("WHEN FETCHING MANUALLY:", userFound)
```

### My Environment

<!--
  Please add any other relevant dependencies to this table at the end.
  For example: Electron, React Native, or NestJS.
-->

| Dependency          | Version  |
| ---                 | ---      |
| Operating System    | Windows 11 |
| Node.js version     | v16.13.1 | <!-- run `node -v` to obtain this -->
| Typescript version  | 4.4.4 | <!-- run `npm list typescript` to obtain this -->
| TypeORM version     | 0.2.41 | <!-- run `npm list typeorm` to obtain this -->


### Additional Context

The generated column feature was implemented in the PostgreSQL driver by https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/6469, so perhaps @TheNoim knows what's missing.

The column seems to be missing from this array: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/90a8deb6383c31686965893cdea96151f40be396/src/query-builder/ReturningResultsEntityUpdator.ts#L172-L187

`column.isGenerated` is false, to be specific.
